$comment: Starter declaration. Uses every parameter type once, so it doubles as a reference. Order is the order the participant sees; `advanced: true` sorts a control under the 'additional parameters' heading. `min`/`max` are the sketch's full domain, `truncatedScale` the narrower range actually offered.

parameters.name: answer1
parameters.label: What would you name this?
parameters.description: A `text` entry is a question, not a control — it is stored as an answer and never reaches the sketch.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.label: spread
parameters.description: How far out the ring sits.

parameters.name: spin
parameters.label: spin
parameters.description: A float-stepped slider. Negative values turn it the other way.

parameters.name: hue
parameters.label: colour
parameters.description: A hue slider. The domain is the whole 0–255 wheel; truncatedScale offers only warm colours, and 30 is the same orange it would be untruncated.

parameters.name: fx_trail
parameters.label: trails
parameters.description: On or off. Gates the slider below it.

parameters.name: trail
parameters.label: trail_length
parameters.description: Belongs to the toggle above: greyed out while trails are off, and its value is kept so turning them back on restores it.

parameters.name: wobble
parameters.label: wobble
parameters.description: Sorted under 'additional parameters' — presentation only, stored and posted exactly like any other.
